$comment: Shadow Trials: an endless ladder of practice fortresses. Tier t uses Keep min(15, 1 + floor((t-1)/tiersPerHall)) (the last Keep level in hall.json); past it (tier 60), defenses grow by powerGrowthPerTier per tier. Rewards are paid once, on the first clear of the next tier. taskMaxGrowth (economy E27, 2026-11-13): a 'clear N Trial tiers' task is offered only while the next N tiers are at or below the player's Keep and their growth past tier 60 is at most this (1.0404 = the first two tiers past the Keep ladder at 2% a tier; 1.1236 at the old 6%); a judgement, not measured against players. 2026-11-16 pass (P1-06, P1-07, P1-17): growth is applied by repeated multiplication (no Math.pow), rewards past the Keep ladder grow by rewardGrowthPerTierBeyond a tier, and modifiers carry an offset so walls double only on Walled Keep tiers and no tier carries two.
$commentCatchUp: P3-06 (PAC-09, 2026-11-18): a village may attempt the first tier of the Keep catchUpKeepsBelow below its own even with lower tiers uncleared; clearing it pays every skipped tier once (a late starter faced dozens of trivial tiers, each a full army for little).
$commentLayoutPower: P4-07 (2026-11-18): re-derived from the raid-layout measurement (bot mix, 20 battles a layout, Keeps 8/12/15 at level bias 0.5; mean destruction kunai_ring 81.7, walled_keep 60.7, mortar_core 68.4, twin_gates 65.4, open_court 85.3): power = 1 + 0.6 x (destruction - mean) / 100, so an easier layout gets stronger defenses.
